Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Parker for 2026, and here is what he found: 5 family events, 3 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (Mayor's Holiday Lighting at O'Brien Park) through December 20 (Hometown Holiday Experience Weekends and The Nutcracker), with the Downtown Parker Holiday Market (December 5) and Holiday with Horses (December 5) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
